messages:
jess: kicking off staggered cutover for release v2.7.1 — route: US then EU then APAC. small window (03:00-04:00 UTC). need quick capacity + pin/rollback guidance.

deploy-bot: Deploy job started for v2.7.1 (sha: a1b2c3d). change window 2026-03-22T03:00Z - 04:00Z. Canary slice -> 2% traffic. notify @oncall-bot for escalation policy.

liam: US warm pool + reserved slots look good. GPUs free: 48, target per-AZ cushion: 10%. can sustain 3x baseline for 30m.

anika: EU warm pool currently at 82% capacity due to batch jobs. I'd like to hold EU until we see US telemetry for 10m. suggest pin EU to v2.7.0 in case we need rollback quickly.

sara: agree with hold. add a strict latency SLO check: if p95 increases >120ms from baseline for 2 consecutive 1m windows, auto-pin to v2.7.0.

mike: saw a small memory pressure bump on the canary in staging earlier (kv cache bump). not sure it matters at low qps, but flagging.

jess: ok holding EU. deploy-bot, set EU holdpoint for 10m after US completes. also add the latency SLO as a failure criteria.

deploy-bot: EU holdpoint configured. Auto-fallback: pin to v2.7.0. Failure rules: p95 latency delta >120ms for 2 consecutive windows OR error rate >0.8% over 5m.

oncall-bot: Oncall alerting: escalation target set to @oncall on first failure and @eng-leads if rollback triggers. runbook link: https://infradocs/release-runbook#staggered-cutover

liam: US is green — smoke tests passed. token throughput good, cpu/gpu headroom at 35%. proceeding to ramp EU on holdpoint.

anika: starting EU ramp now (manually lifting hold). monitoring dashboards up: https://console.redwood/release/v2.7.1/eu

sara: watching latency. p95 baseline 130ms -> 139ms now. within threshold. continue. :eyes:

mike: small spike in outlier goroutines seen at EU-2. increased tail but not over threshold. logging snippet: `2026-03-22T03:14:22Z WARN kvcache: miss-rate 6.2%`

jess: if miss-rate keeps rising past 8% we should consider rolling back EU only. set manual pin command ready.

sara: p95 jumped to 255ms (2 consecutive 1m windows). triggering fallback.

deploy-bot: Automated action: pin EU to v2.7.0 (rollback) as per policy. Rolling back slice EU now.

anika: confirmed rollback completed on EU. error rate and latency returning to baseline. Great job catching the kvcache pattern.

jess: decision notes for release log: US successful, EU rolled back due to kvcache tail causing p95 breach, APAC paused (waiting on EU stability). follow-up: add kvcache guard + warmup flags before trying EU again. I'll draft release notes and schedule a postmortem check-in.

oncall-bot: Incident stub created: #INC-2026-812 - EU kvcache tail during v2.7.1; assigned to anika/mike.

liam: thumbs on capacity — APAC we should only resume after kvcache mitigations and a 2-hour warmup window.

jess: agreed. holding APAC. summary posted to #release-notes once I finish a short writeup. :thumbsup:
